confidence_words.high: one-to-one or point-in-polygon join on current sources
confidence_words.medium: join holds but is shared, nearest-within-10 m, or a coverage test
confidence_words.low: exact key match against a stale or sparsely filled source
confidence_words.note: Provisional words for the UI. Not the NA-86 exact/good/weak/refused scale (still open).
